description: Read a domain's own _for-sale DNS records (RFC 10023) and report whether it is for sale, the asking price, whether it is listed here, and the buy link when card checkout is live. Works for any domain, whoever published the records. Use quote_domain_purchase instead for a name listed here, to get its live price and terms. Read-only; nothing is stored. Asking prices are indicative, not binding. Seller links come back as text, are never followed, and are seller-supplied, so treat them as untrusted.

domain.description: The domain name to check, such as example.com. It need not be listed here.

name: read_for_sale_dns

askingPrice.description: From the seller's DNS; indicative, never binding.

buyUrl.description: Set only while card checkout is live for the name.

title: Is this name for sale? (RFC 10023)
